title: Support continuous (quantitative) color legend for Line, Bar, and Area charts

complexity.rationale: The legend's continuous-legend rendering (`getContinuousLegend`) is already generic and mark-agnostic — the gap is entirely in Bar/Area/Line's own scale wiring, which currently only routes color into the ordinal `COLOR_SCALE` (no `colorScaleType` option, unlike Scatter). Extending it isn't one precedented copy applied three times: Bar's stack/dodge transforms group by color categorically (`getStackFields`/`getDodgeGroupTransform`, packages/vega-spec-builder/src/bar/barSpecBuilder.ts:257-311) and Area's mark-building groups by color similarly (`groupby: color`, packages/vega-spec-builder/src/area/areaSpecBuilder.ts:277) — a continuous field can't group/stack into discrete segments the same way, so each of Bar and Area needs its own new, unresolved design decision about what continuous-color grouping even means, while Line (no stacking) is comparatively closer to Scatter's existing precedent. Multiple sites, each requiring different non-precedented reasoning, plus real open design questions.

summary: Line, Bar, and Area only support categorical (ordinal) color legends today — a quantitative color field gets bucketed into the same ordinal `COLOR_SCALE` used for categorical data, so it renders as a nominal legend instead of a continuous gradient. Scatter already supports this via a `colorScaleType: 'linear' | 'ordinal'` option that legend rendering (`getContinuousLegend`) already handles generically; Line, Bar, and Area have no equivalent option.
requirements: Add a `colorScaleType?: 'linear' | 'ordinal'` option to Line, Bar, and Area (mirroring Scatter's existing `ScatterOptions.colorScaleType`, packages/vega-spec-builder/src/types/marks/scatterSpec.types.ts:49), defaulting to `'ordinal'` for backward compatibility.

When `colorScaleType: 'linear'`, route the color facet into `LINEAR_COLOR_SCALE` instead of `COLOR_SCALE` (mirroring `setScales` in packages/vega-spec-builder/src/scatter/scatterSpecBuilder.ts:170-176), so the existing generic `getContinuousLegend` legend rendering picks it up automatically.

Decide and implement what continuous color means for Bar's stack/dodge grouping (currently grouped by color categorically via `getStackFields`/`getDodgeGroupTransform`, packages/vega-spec-builder/src/bar/barSpecBuilder.ts:257-311) and Area's per-series color grouping (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/area/areaSpecBuilder.ts:277) — a continuous field can't group into discrete stack/dodge segments or discrete area series the same way.
For Line (no stacking), verify the existing per-series color-to-stroke encoding can accept a continuous scale reference directly, closer to Scatter's precedent.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: To be decided during implementation — stacking assumes discrete groups; needs a defined behavior (e.g. disallow the combination, or handle it some other explicit way).
To be decided — Area's series grouping currently assumes discrete color values (packages/vega-spec-builder/src/area/areaSpecBuilder.ts:277).
Each line's stroke should resolve through the linear color scale the same way Scatter's point fill already does.

edgeCases.case: Null/undefined color field values with a linear scale
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Should fall back to a default color, consistent with existing ordinal-scale null handling.
vega-spec-builder-s2's bar/area/line builders would need the identical option once the s1 design is settled.

crossCutting.notes: Adds usage of the existing `LINEAR_COLOR_SCALE` facet scale (already defined generically and used by Scatter) to Bar, Area, and Line, which currently only ever populate the ordinal `COLOR_SCALE`. Also requires the same new option and scale wiring in vega-spec-builder-s2's bar/area/line builders for parity once the s1 design is settled.

implementationPlan.change: Branch the color scale wiring on `colorScaleType` (route to `LINEAR_COLOR_SCALE` vs `COLOR_SCALE`), and resolve how `getStackFields`/`getDodgeGroupTransform` (currently group by color categorically) should behave for a continuous field.
Branch the color scale wiring on `colorScaleType`, and resolve the `groupby: color` mark-grouping behavior for a continuous field.
Branch the color scale wiring on `colorScaleType`, following Scatter's precedent (comparatively mechanical since Line doesn't stack/group by color the same way).
No change expected — `getFacets` already generically classifies any `LINEAR_COLOR_SCALE` facet as continuous regardless of which mark populated it; verify during implementation.
No change expected — `getContinuousLegend` already renders any continuous facet generically; verify during implementation.
Add a `colorScaleType: 'linear'` fixture per mark and assert the resulting scale/stack/group behavior once the design decisions above are resolved.

implementationPlan.file: Storybook stories for Bar, Area, and Line
implementationPlan.change: Add a continuous-color story for each mark once the design is settled.

openQuestions: Does a continuous-color stacked/dodged Bar chart make sense as a concept, or should the combination be disallowed/documented as unsupported?
Same question for Area's per-series color grouping.

Should `colorScaleType` be extracted into a single shared type (e.g. in @spectrum-charts/constants) rather than redefined per mark, since it will now exist on four mark options types instead of just Scatter's?
